item.title: Meghan Markle's Brand in Free Fall, Amy Griffin's Reputation Rehab, and Selma Blair's Strange Apology, with Maureen Callahan | Ep. 1441 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Maureen Callahan, host of "The Nerve," to discuss the latest spin on behalf of Meghan Markle from her personal outlet People magazine, new questions emerging about why she didn’t speak out over the allegations against her dad for years, her absurd appearance on the red carpet amid all this drama, why Oprah Winfrey would be endorsing Meghan Markle’s $250 “basket,” major questions that are haunting Meghan’s father and mother, actress Dakota Johnson's bizarre behavior, her pretending she hates being a celebrity despite her obviously staged photographs and non-stop interviews,  the truth about the ways Amy Griffin is trying to sanitize her reputation, how she is targeting journalists and their children, the serious questions about who is telling the truth about "The Tell," all of the celebrities and journalists who promoted "The Tell” that should address it now, how Celine Dion could have “Stiff Person Syndrome” when she dances around on stage, the questions about the diagnosis, Alanis Morrissette now saying she is pansexual for some reason, Selma Blair’s apology for her airplane meltdown and biting and kicking incident, and more.
